item.title: Bhubaneswar: Niladri Vihar murder case accused Dinesh surrenders before police
item.description: Bhubaneswar: The main accused in the Niladri Vihar murder case in Bhubaneswar, Dinesh Nayak alias Dinabandhu, surrendered before police at Jagatsinghpur police station on Tuesday evening. Following his surrender, a team from Chandrasekharpur police reached Jagatsinghpur to bring the accused to Bhubaneswar for questioning. The case is linked to the murder of 27-year-old Satyabrata Pradhan, who was allegedly hacked to death late on Sunday night at Niladri Vihar under Chandrasekharpur police limits

item.description: New Delhi: India’s left-handed opener Abhishek Sharma is in doubt for Thursday’s clash against Namibia in the 2026 Men’s T20 World Cup after being admitted to a private hospital in New Delhi due to stomach infection. item.title: Mass shooting in Canada's British Columbia leaves 10 people dead
item.description: British Columbia: At least 10 people, including the gunman, are dead and several are injured after a mass shooting in Canada's British Columbia, police said. item.description: Bhubaneswar: Normal life across Odisha is likely to be affected on Thursday as several central trade unions have called for a nationwide strike on February 12. item.description: Balasore: At least five people were injured, two of them critically, after a car rammed into a container on National Highway-16 near Talanagar under Soro police limits in Odisha's Balasore district today.
